overview_description.description:
Botter.ai is a specialized enterprise AI platform built for Arabic and English-speaking markets. The platform enables organizations to automate and improve customer interactions through conversational AI, smart chatbots, voice bots, AI services, LLM technology, NLP, analytics, ticketing, campaign automation, and omnichannel customer engagement.

Botter supports customer communication across websites, mobile apps, social channels, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, Microsoft Teams, IVR, and contact center environments. The platform is designed for enterprise deployment across cloud, private cloud, and on-premises infrastructure, with integrations into contact center solutions such as Genesys and Cisco.

With a strong focus on Arabic NLP and NLU, Botter helps enterprises detect and understand multiple Arabic dialects while supporting multilingual AI experiences. The product suite includes no-code chatbot building, voice enablement, customer analytics, escalation analysis, CSAT tracking, NLP accuracy monitoring, and campaign management
